what: SPEED-RT surface stage's frozen configuration (the stage's section): the pods' hardware, the session's counts and the items' sizes. The timing sets are in sets_surf.json, the Grace conversion's rule and NVIDIA's values in grace_fit.py, the reference circuits in circuits/ref_circuits.json.

hosts.pod_cpu: the pod's host CPU (model and container quota recorded per session: META.json, prescreen.json) serves CUDA-Q's host-to-host BP-OSD only
hosts.cpu_worker: every CPU part: the Linux workstation, AMD Ryzen 9 9950X (Ubuntu 24.04), the CPU worker; one fresh pinned process per slot
